definition: Wispr Flow is a speech recognition and dictation software application developed by Wispr AI.
details: It converts spoken language into text across multiple platforms, including macOS, Windows, iOS, and Android. The software integrates with system-level input fields, allowing voice input in various applications.

explainer.lead: Wispr Flow is a speech recognition and dictation application developed by Wispr AI. It matters because it brings voice-to-text input across major platforms.

tiers.eli5: You talk and your words appear as text in whatever app you're using, on your phone or computer.
tiers.practitioner: The software integrates with system-level input fields so voice input works in various applications across macOS, Windows, iOS and Android. A pitfall is assuming it only works inside one app rather than across system input fields.
tiers.paperLevel: A speech recognition and dictation software application that converts spoken language into text across multiple platforms and integrates with system-level input fields. No formal definition or limits are given.

explainer.example: A user speaks into an input field in a third-party application and the spoken words are inserted as text.
